articleTitle: Comparative Study of Slam Algorithms for Mobile Robots in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The localization and map building technology of mobile robot is the key to realize robot indoor autonomous navigation technology. This paper introduces Gmapping SLAM, Hector SLAM, Cartographer SLAM and ORB SLAM2, compares the above algorithms, and expounds the advantages and disadvantages of different algorithms and applicable conditions. The Kinect V2 depth camera is calibrated. On the built mobile robot platform, the ROS operating system is used to verify the four algorithms. According to the map constructed in the experiment, it is concluded that the cartographer SLAM algorithm of laser slam in indoor environment has high accuracy and efficiency, and can be used directly. ORB SLAM2 is rich in 3D features, but the feature points are sparse, so it is difficult to use the map directly.

articleTitle: A Simulation System for Testing Robotic Navigation Based on CoppeliaSim and ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The navigation system is one of the most prominent and essential part of robotic autonomy. Along with more advanced navigation techniques are developed for autonomous robotics, it becomes more crucial to test the algorithms in simulation before applying them to real-world robotic platforms. This paper presents a combined simulation framework for testing robotic navigation algorithms, which is based on CoppeliaSim and ROS. An overview of each system is provided. Then, how the combined framework may be used for stand-alone simulated development is described in detail. Lastly, the robotic navigation experiment is conducted in a simulation scenario, where the robot is desired to navigate to a goal. The results of the experiment verify the effectiveness of the proposed simulation framework.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Design of Multi-robot Formation Based on Leader-Follower
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Trajectory tracking error of Multi-robot formation is easily caused by external environment interference. To address this issue, this paper introduces a control method based on consistency. First, the trajectory tracking controller of leader robot is designed based on back-stepping. Second, a stable communication topology is designed. Accordingly, the formation motion can be reset quickly after being disturbed by obstacles and outside world. Consequently, stability of the formation motion can be maintained, which enables the robot formation to track the expected trajectory. Finally, its effectiveness is verified by numerical simulation. The results show that our approach realizes Multi-robot formation with accurate trajectory tracking control.

articleTitle: Gravity Compensation Based Control for Lower-Limb Load-Bearing Exoskeleton
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Exoskeleton developed for military purpose is to enhance one’s endurance and strength, and to reduce operator’s energy expenditure during walking with payloads under the assistance of exoskeleton. The idea to control this kind of exoskeleton is to compensate the weight from the exoskeleton and the payloads it carries, and at the same time to follow the operators' movement. A control strategy refers to this idea is proposed. The gravity and friction of the lower-limb exoskeleton are analyzed based on a simplified model. A real exoskeleton prototype is constructed for verification. The experiment about energy expenditure quantified by PCI with the assistance of exoskeleton shows a satisfactory result.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Digital Twin-Based Enterprise Architecture Digital Control Platform for Provincial Electrical Power Company
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: With the deep integration of energy revolution and digital revolution, various new businesses, new formats and new business models are constantly emerging in the electric power industry, and new digital technologies are developing rapidly. The enterprise architecture in urgent need of power grid can be rapidly transformed to keep pace with the development of The Times. But at present, the company enterprise architecture because of the lack of effective management means, there is unclear, architecture standard not unified architecture assets to master problems such as nonstandard, architecture, control, produce the repeated construction and technical route of complicated system function, design, development and inconsistent problems, unable to meet the demand of power grid enterprise digital transition quickly, Therefore, based on the SG-EA architecture standard of State Grid Co., LTD., combined with the current situation and problems of enterprise architecture management of provincial power grid, the digital twin model was used to carry out the research and design of enterprise architecture digital control platform to promote the online maintenance of architecture assets and the management and control of architecture assets in the whole process of the project. To fully support the panoramic visualization of assets of enterprise architecture, lean management and control of the whole process and intelligent asset analysis, ensure that the enterprise architecture has a clear background, standard architecture, unified standards and implementation in place, effectively avoid problems such as repeated system construction and inconsistent technology, and help achieve the strategic goals of the company.

articleTitle: Overview of Simulation Architectures Supporting Live Virtual Constructive (LVC) Integrated Training
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: For Improving the interoperability, reusability and composability of simulation resources, creating a unified Live-Virtual-Constructive (LVC) integrated simulation architecture has always been a major goal in the modeling and simulation (M&S) field. This paper summarizes the creation process and potential architectures involved. Firstly, the developing history of distributed simulation architecture is introduced from SIMMNET to JLVC2020. Then, the simulation architectures of TENA, JLCV Federation and JLVC2020, which have great potential in the future, are elaborated. Finally, the near-to medium-term future construction plan of LVC integrated simulation architecture is given through three development routes. The related discussion has important reference value for promoting the construction capacity of joint training simulation.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm Based on Improved BiasSVD
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In the era of information explosion, the internet platform with massive information provides personalized services for users by using recommendation system. With users and projects growing ever more, the data sparsity problem may affect the cold start of projects. To solve the above problem, an improved collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the biasedSVD algorithm is used to reduced dimension of user rating matrix, which brings the less complexity and alleviates the problem of data of sparsity. Secondly, the user's behaviors are analyzed and a novel weight named the time-preference weighting factor is proposed to describe the user's rating preference for items. Experimental results based on MovieLens data set show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-atrs.

articleTitle: Dynamic Parameter Identification and Collision Detection of Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: A method based on MD-H model is proposed to establish the geometric parameter error model of SCARA robot and carry out error compensation. In this paper, by analyzing the causes of robot positioning accuracy error, the geometric parameter error model of SCARA robot is established through the modified MD-H model. The Jacobian matrix of the robot is calculated, and the redundancy analysis of the columns of the J matrix is carried out, and the redundant parameter columns are eliminated. Then the same world coordinate system of laser tracker and SCARA robot is established by axis method. Finally, the absolute coordinate data of SCARA robot before and after correction are measured by laser tracker. From the measured data, it can be obtained that the maximum absolute positioning accuracy before the robot correction is 7.4 mm, and the maximum absolute positioning accuracy after the robot correction is 0.933 mm, which is 6.9 times higher than that before.

articleTitle: Obstacle Recognition and Path Planning of UAV Flight
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of classification and detection of obstacles and flight path planning in the process of UAV obstacle avoidance, YOLO is used the algorithm detects the category information of obstacles. Based on the construction of indoor 3D maps, the TSP algorithm is used to detect obstacles. Research on the path planning of man-machines, establish the control mathematical model of obstacle avoidance flight under hypothetical scenarios, and obtain the best flight path through simulation analysis and comparison.

articleTitle: Efficient Loop Closure Detection Method for Lidar SLAM in Challenging Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: With the development of automatic driving cars, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) becomes a widely discussed topic. Loop closure detection, as an important module in lidar slam, can provide strong constraint for localization and mapping. In classical lidar SLAM algorithm, traditional loop closure detection method often fails to find out the matching nodes, or even has false positive results, especially in challenging environment like the crossroads or sharp turns. In this paper, a lidar SLAM loop closure detection method using adjacent nodes to check the reliability is introduced. A series of experiments is implemented to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Partition Coverage Planning Method Based on Adjustable Rectangular Decomposition for Airport Pavement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The complete coverage detection of airport pavement is one of the important tasks to ensure the safety of civil aviation. Due to the large coverage area of the airport and the rigid requirements for ultra-high security, humans and robots are required to interact when performing specific coverage detection tasks. Therefore, it is a challenge to divide the large airport environment into suitable working areas. In this paper, we propose a partition coverage planning method based on the adjustable rectangular decomposition environment. First, we use rectangles to decompose the environment into the initial working areas without obstacles, where the size of the rectangle can be adjusted according to the task requirements. Then we design the rules for optimizing the working areas so that the optimized working areas are more reasonable and can be directly used for coverage planning by the line scan method. Finally, simulation experiments show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Parameter Identification and Collision Detection of Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: A robot dynamic parameter identification method based on improved linear friction is proposed. In this paper, the Newton Euler method is used to model the dynamics of the robot, and the dynamic expression is derived. Taylor expansion is used to linearize the commonly used nonlinear Stribeck friction model. Then the linear model and the minimum inertia parameter set of the robot are analyzed, and a set of minimum inertia parameters of the robot is derived. The linear expression of joint torque with respect to a set of identifiable parameters is obtained. The finite Fourier series is studied as the excitation trajectory of the dynamic parameter identification experiment. Combined with the minimum condition number, the optimization objective function of the excitation trajectory parameters is proposed, and the excitation trajectory parameters are calculated by MATLAB fmincon function. Fourier series is used as the excitation trajectory for experiment, and the identifiable dynamic parameter set is identified by the least square method. Using the dynamic parameters identified by the proposed method for dynamic modeling, the theoretical joint torque of the robot can be obtained, and the correctness and feasibility of the algorithm are verified by collision detection experiments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control for Collaborative Robot Based on Nominal Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The seven-degree-of-freedom (7dof) collaborative robot is a type of nonlinear system with multiple inputs, multiple outputs, parameter uncertainties, external disturbances and unmodeled dynamics. Due to the external disturbances, such as friction, uncertainty information and parameters will be generated in the system, which can affect the operation of the robotic arm. Sliding mode control has the advantages of being insensitive to changes in external disturbances and internal disturbances. Based on this, this paper designed a model-based adaptive fuzzy sliding mode controller. On the basis of compensating the unmodeled characteristics of the system, the controller can be deduced by adaptively estimating the uncertainty upper bound, which can eliminate the chattering problem of the control law well. Through the simulation of the seven-degree-of-freedom cooperative robot, it is known that this scheme has higher tracking accuracy than ordinary sliding mode control schemes. Furthermore, it greatly improves the robustness to external interference, system uncertain information and parameter changes.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Task Allocation for Airfield Pavement Detection Tasks
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: When multi-robot systems execute large-area detection tasks, such as airport runways, taxiways, and parking aprons, it is necessary to consider the execution time of the detection tasks and the entry and exit positions of the robots. To shorten the overall time for executing inspection tasks, it is necessary to ensure that each robot can be allocated a balanced task during task allocation. In this paper, based on the sequential single-item (SSI) auction algorithm, a multi-robot task allocation method that considers the total distance of the robot and the area of the detection area is proposed to solve the problem of unbalanced robot load tasks. It can be better applied to a large area detection environment. In addition, this method can also obtain better experimental results for different priority detection tasks.

articleTitle: Optimization of PMSM Position Servo System Based on Self-anti-disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) servo systems are strongly coupled, parametrically time-varying nonlinear systems. Self-anti-disturbance control can expand the internal and external disturbances in the servo system into a total disturbance by a state observer (ESO), and compensate the observed unknown disturbances accurately in feedforward real-time, so that the servo control has good anti-disturbance capability. However, a large number of parameters need to be rectified in the traditional self-turbulence controller, which brings many inconveniences to the practicality of self-turbulence control. In this paper, PI control and second-order linear self-rejecting (LADRC) control are combined to design the PMSM position servo, and the parameters of the linear self-rejecting controller are tuned by the bandwidth method. In addition, online inertia identification and compensation are used to improve the immunity of the whole servo system and to reduce the number of necessary parameter adjustments while ensuring the immunity of the servo system as much as possible. The numerical simulation shows that the method has good immunity and robustness.

articleTitle: Response Surface Methods Study for Industrial Robot Natural Frequency Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Natural frequency information of industrial robot can be used for vibration suppression in robot configuration optimization. Robot natural frequency in whole working space is able to be predicted by a mathematical model fitted with the data of several sample configurations selected through Response Surface Methods (RSM). As there exists different types of RSMs, this paper aims at choosing an appropriate method for sample selection. Through analysis and practical experiments, Central Composite Inscribed Design is indicated to be the optimal one.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Energy-Saving Smart Lighting Control Based on Deep Q-Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Smart lighting systems play a more and more important role in people's work and life, since efficient adaptive and energy-saving lighting control is a necessary way to improve people's quality of life and create an economical, comfortable, and environmentally friendly lighting environment. To improve the energy consumption in an indoor environment and satisfy body comfort, this paper proposes an adaptive and energy-saving smart lighting control algorithm based on a Deep Q-Network algorithm (DQN), wherein the light number, illuminance and body comfort are considered. The proposed algorithm has some research in other fields, but no one has used it in smart lighting control yet, and few people consider body comfort in the existing energysaving control research of smart lighting. The simulation results show that the proposed DQN based control algorithm can save power up to 62% without body comfort loss, compared to the traditional lighting system. Further, there is no additional delay under the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: Time Optimal Trajectory Planning Based on Redundant Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: A time-optimal trajectory planning algorithm based on redundant manipulator is proposed. In order to improve the operation efficiency of the manipulator, based on the traditional high-order polynomial trajectory planning, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the time, shorten the total operation time, and obtain the smooth and continuous operation trajectory satisfying the kinematic constraints. The experimental results show that the manipulator runs smoothly without vibration and maintains good motion performance, which verifies the effective feasibility of the trajectory algorithm.

articleTitle: A Local Planning Method Based on Graph Optimization Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: To generate a collision free local trajectory respect to the dynamic and kinematic constrains of car-like mobile robots, a local planning method is proposed in this paper. The method generates a local path in the graph optimization framework of the Timed Elastic Band (TEB) algorithm firstly. The generated local path is made of a series of waypoints and concerned with collision avoidance, curvature constraints. Then some post-processes are offered: The fifth-order splines are used to get a smooth path through these waypoints; Finally, shortest time trajectory generation algorithm along the given path generates a shortest time trajectory satisfying the dynamic and kinematic constraints.

articleTitle: Classification of Air Conditioner Sound Based on Mel Joint Features and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The air conditioner sound classification model can automatically identify abnormal sound of air conditioners, which is more efficient than the manual method in judging the quality of air conditioners. The key to sound classification is that the extracted features must have enough discrimination for different sound types. At the same time, the network used should conform to the characteristics of the data as much as possible. In this paper, a new classification model of air conditioner sound is proposed based on three types of sound data in SDU-Haier-ND data set. Firstly, the Mel spectral features and Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients of sound signals are extracted to form joint features. Then, the training feature set is input into bidirectional long short-term memory network for model training. Finally, the trained model is used to classify the test feature set. The experimental results show that the model has good classification ability.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Clamping Force Analysis Based on the End Clamping System of Polishing Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: According to the principle of pneumatic technology, the pneumatic technology is combined with the manipulator, and a pneumatic gripper suitable for grasping small parts of watch case is designed, and the three-dimensional modeling is carried out. Since the clamped part is a watch case, a three-finger inner support pneumatic gripper is selected. According to the design plan of the pneumatic gripper, a combination of pressure sensor and gripper is mainly designed, and then the complex curved surface flexible polishing industrial robot is analyzed. The key points and difficulties of the structure design of the end-holding mechanism are analyzed, and the holding force and its influence are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Leg Transmission Mechanism of Quadruped Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In order to enhance the movement ability and bearing capacity of quadruped robot, a flexible leg of Quadruped Robot Based on double rope sheave transmission mechanism is proposed. The kinematics equation of flexible leg of quadruped robot is established, and its forward solution and motion space are obtained. The simulation model of quadruped robot flexible leg is established, and the changes of joint output torque and foot angular velocity are measured. It is concluded that the proposed new quadruped robot flexible leg has high load, strong obstacle crossing ability and movement stability.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Welding Robots Based on Developed Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of optimal welding path of welding robots, an developed whale optimization algorithm is proposed. In this paper, the layout of 14 welding spots is analyzed and simplified as Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The mathematical models of welding path optimization are established. On the basis of analyzing the principle of whale optimization algorithm, WOA searching flow is redesigned and searching ability is enhanced. Experiments of 5 testing functions indicate that the developed WOA has advantages (GSWOA), such as greater global searching ability, higher optimizing accuracy and so on. The sequence of welding path points is taken as the search agent of WOA and the shortest path distance is taken as the fitness function so that the developed WOA has been used in path planning of robots. Matlab software is employed to realize the simulation experiment of path planning. The simulation results show that the developed WOA can significantly shorten the welding distance and enhance the production efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Explosion-Proof and Sealing Performance of Underground UAV in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Taking the explosion-proof structure and sealing system of underground UAV in coal mine as the research object, the theoretical analysis and structural design are carried out, the finite element analysis is carried out through software, and the performance experiment is carried out based on the prototype to ensure the reliability of explosion-proof and sealing performance. At the same time, the correlation conclusion between technical parameters such as sealing pressure difference and compression and explosion-proof and sealing performance is obtained.

articleTitle: Supercapacitor Dynamic Control Suite for Achieving High Transient State Power in Robot System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Lithium batteries, as the energy source of robots, suffer from the problem of insufficient instantaneous maximum power and battery degradation due to prolonged high power output. Li-battery-supercapacitor composite power supply is a better solution, and the authors propose a hardware control circuit to limit the maximum power, which can switch the output mode automatically. Depending on the load power state, the power margin in addition to the power required by the load is dynamically allocated to the control strategy for charging the supercapacitor. The remaining power is used to charge the supercapacitor, which not only achieves full utilization of the battery energy, but also protects the power supply from damage due to overcurrent output and ensures that the supercapacitor has enough energy for long-time motion. The feasibility of the constant power battery protection and dynamic power distribution control strategy is verified through physical prototype testing, and the strategy improves the power performance of the robot.

articleTitle: Vehicle High Beam Light Detection Based on Zoom Binocular Camera and Light Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Abuses of high beam light cause numerous traffic accidents every year, which is a big threat to people's lives and property. Detection of high beam light in traffic surveillance will urge drivers use high beam light normatively, and reduce traffic accidents. Most existing researches focus on vehicle detection, vehicle classification, or vehicle license plate recognition, but research about high beam light detection is rare. In this paper, a high beam light detection system based on zoom binocular camera and light sensor array is developed. By combining the image processing and light sensor detection, vehicle with high beam light on can be captured with a low computational consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Appointment Scheduling of CT Examination Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Medical dispatching system is the key to affect hospital equipment dispatching. During the COVID-19 outbreak, there was a dramatic increase in hospital patients. This poses a new challenge to the medical dispatching system. How can the dispatching system operate normally in the face of a sharp increase in patients under the sudden epidemic situation. Therefore, a reasonable scheduling system can check more patients and treat the disease as early as possible. In addition, it is a vital means to curb the spread of the epidemic CT were examined by aiming at the actual time of arrival of the uncertainty, the traditional time to the delay of the plan for the service index distribution of CT model, based on the introduction of buffer time for robustness index, the optimality of discrete CT appointment scheduling and robustness tradeoffs, established the CT examination appointment scheduling model based on genetic algorithm. The objective function is to minimize the total planning delay time of patients, and the simulation is carried out by genetic algorithm. Finally, Compare the models and draw a conclusion. The final results show that the anti-interference ability of the robust model considering the buffer time is significantly better than that of the traditional strategy.

articleTitle: The Development of an Omnidirectional Mobile Robot Based on Hub Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: To enable the ability of moving in a narrow space, the robots are required to move in all directions. However, traditional robots with omnidirectional mobile function are easily wearing, with poor bearing capacity, and with complex structure. We designed and proposed an omnidirectional mobile robot (OMR) with the active split offset caster (ASoC) wheelset as the driving wheelset. Specifically, we first established the mathematical model of the robot based on the differential drive principle. Then the mathematical model is verified with synchronized real and simulated movement of the designed robot. A motion capture system is used to track the actual motion trajectory. Finally, a road test experiment is applied to test the stability of the designed robot in a real environment. The tiny differences between real and simulated trajectory show that the designed robot has the ability to move omnidirectionally in a narrow space. The road test experiment proves the advanced adaptability in real environment. Therefore, the designed robot can assist in a narrow space.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on Wavelet Packet and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Rolling bearing is a key part of the robot, but it is difficult to directly analyze the original vibration signal to detect the fault. This article proposes a fault diagnosis method combining wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) and Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network. The wavelet packet decomposition is used to divide the fault signals into multiple frequency bands and then exact the energy of every bands. After the fault features are exacted, the RBF neural network takes the fault signal features as input and inputs their corresponding failure modes. Using bearing data set from Case Western Reserve University to carry out the simulation experiment, the results show that the proposed method can accurately classify rolling bearing faults.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigations of Heat-Assisted Drilling of Superalloy Inconel 718 with Coated Tool and Uncoated Tool
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: This paper studies the processing of coated tools under heat-assisted machining conditions for Inconel 718. It is found that the performance of coated tools under heat-assisted machining conditions is better than that at room temperature, which can effectively improve the machining process. In the process of drilling Inconel 718, it was found that there is a suitable hot machining temperature to minimize the drilling thrust force. When the hot machining temperature exceeds a certain temperature, the coating superiority of the coated tool will disappear.

articleTitle: Muscle Characteristics of Flexible Redundant Hybrid Manipulators Based on Pneumatic Artificical Muscles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: To solve the challenging issue of humanoid robot joints trajectory tracking that are actuated by flexible redundant hybrid Pneumatic Artificical Muscles (PAMs). A new type of internal and external PAMs non-uniform cross-distributed mechanism with two variant design are proposed in this paper. And then kinematic analysis are calculted, influence factors such as configuration of manipulators, monoarticular PAMs circle radius, biarticular PAMs circle radius, hight of supporting bar are taken into consideration to analyze the manipulator through simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Low-Cost Quadruped Robot with Joint Fault-Tolerant Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The quadruped robots among legged robots have been developed for scientific research and human life due to the better-complicated terrain adaptability. A novel quadruped robot designed with low cost and low energy consumption is proposed in this work, and each leg is actuated by direct drive servos. The three degrees of freedom leg kinematics are calculated, and the trotting gait algorithm is adopted to make the robot capable of walking. Under complex tasks, the multi-joint and multi-degree-of-freedom drive of the robot mean potential failures. A fault-tolerant control strategy for the joint stick is adopted, maintaining part of workability when the fault occurs. The walking experiment has confirmed that when the quadruped robot joint faults, it can still work with the performance degradation. Therefore, the robot has higher reliability and fault tolerance to complete complex tasks and explore extraterrestrial planets instead of wheeled vehicles.

articleTitle: Improvement Method of Heat-Resistant Optical Fibre Composite Low-Voltage Cable Based on Multi-physics Simulation and Experimental Research
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The optical fiber composite low-voltage cable (OPLC) is an important component in the power system. During the operating state, the short-term high temperature generated on the composite cable, which has a certain negative impact on the fiber attenuation in the OPLC. Aiming at the problem, in this paper, a three-dimensional simulation model of heat-resistant OPLC cable based on basic theories of electromagnetics, heat transfer, solid mechanics and optics was established in COMSOL Multiphysics simulation software. The simulation model was modified based on the thermal effect due to the flow of current, the reaction of temperature to resistance, thermal expansion theory, and Lorentz's law. Combined with the results of the simulation analysis and simulation test, the improvement scheme and structure of OPLC heat-resistant technology were proposed by optimizing and improving OPLC cable structure, cable material selection, and production process. The OPLC's heat-resistance characteristics satisfy a fiber attenuation variation of no more than 0.15 dB/km at a temperature of 10% above the maximum standard temperature of the cable for 15 minutes.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Airport Tanker Truck Scheduling Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Airport special vehicles can efficiently and orderly complete a series of ground support services, which play a key role in the normal operation of flights. Take an airport as an example, the problem of airport special vehicle scheduling is studied and analyzed, and an airport tanker truck scheduling model with time windows is established. The model aims at the minimum number of tanker truck performing tasks and the shortest total travel path of the vehicle. Each flight can only be served once and only by one vehicle. The starting point of each sub-path is the fuel truck depot. The fuel demand of each sub-route cannot exceed the maximum load capacity of the tanker truck. The aircraft must be served within the time window. Using particle swarm algorithm to solve the problem of airport tanker truck scheduling, take flight data from a domestic airport as an example for simulation experiment, compare with saving algorithm and genetic algorithm under the same experimental conditions, experiments show that the designed algorithm is more effective and more resource-saving in solving the problem of airport fuel truck scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on the Structure of Quadruped Robots
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The purpose of this R&D is to study the motion characteristics of the quadruped robot. Several different model mechanisms were selected and applied to the quadruped robot during the R&D process, and finally the solutions were simulated and compared. We mainly used SolidWorks to model the quadruped robot, motion analysis of the quadruped robot, Adams virtual simulation, Visio mechanism model sketching, and designed our own simulation software using MATLAB GUI. It is found that there are various solutions for the gait equation of the quadruped robot, among which the most suitable one is to use the cycloid equation to control the footing point of the foot end coordinates, and then solve the rotation angle of the joint motor by forward and inverse kinematic solution.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Acquisition Based on Improved SGM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Stereo matching is an important part of point cloud acquisition of three-dimensional objects. Aiming at the problem of low timeliness and accuracy of disparity map generated by traditional SGM algorithm, this paper proposes an improved SGM stereo matching algorithm based on texture optimization. The standard image provided by Middlebury platform is processed by image preprocessing, camera calibration, stereo correction, stereo matching and point cloud acquisition. The SGM algorithm and the improved SGM algorithm are tested on the OpenCV platform. The experimental results show that the improved SGM algorithm improves the accuracy and efficiency of stereo matching.

articleTitle: Comparable Study on Readability of Machine Generated News and Human News
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Traditional news publishing and transmission are ever changing with the development of integration of artificial intelligence and journalism. The quality of machine generated news has gained wide attention in both journalism and engineering. We build an English comparative corpus containing machine generated news and human written news about several topics. An empirical study is carried on the readability of machine generated articles and news written by journalists. The news topics cover the range of financial, politics and sports. This study compares the distribution of machine news and human news on eight widely used readability indices. The results of hypothesis-testing indicate that the readability of machine generated news can vary with different news themes but still has a significant gap comparing with readability of human news.

articleTitle: Optimization Design for Link Structure of Heavy-Duty Transfer Robot Based on Response Surface Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In this paper, the statics analysis of the heavy-duty transfer robot is first performed to determine the maximum stress of each link in the dangerous position. The minimum mass of each arm is taken as the optimization target, and the strength conditions and deformation are the constraint conditions. Using the target optimization function of ANSYS Workbench, the thickness and width of each arm are optimized. And based on the optimized arm structure size, the robot structure is designed. The results show that the optimized mass of the forearm and the forearm support link is decreased by 24.66% and 28.71% respectively, so the lightweight of the heavy-duty transfer robot is realized.

articleTitle: Research on the Comfort of Automotive Seats Based on Multi-software Collaborative Design
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The design of ergonomic adjustable seat is based on the driver's demand for comfort and automatic adjustment of the driver's seat. The relevant seat size is designed by ergonomic method to meet human comfort. Firstly, CATIA software is used to model the seat in 3D dimensions, and then the three-dimensional model is imported into JACK and RAMSIS software for simulation analysis, dimension design and driver fatigue test. Finally, MATLAB was used to model the ECU system analysis of the automotive electronic controller for the automatic seat adjustment design, and the controller parameters were optimized on the basis of the simulation results. The design dimensions of the car seat and the optimal control parameters of the automatic adjustment control system are obtained to meet the requirements of human comfort, providing a certain theoretical reference basis for the subsequent research on the comfort of the car seat and the research and development of the automatic adjustment control system.

articleTitle: BP-Network Based Optimized Stable Curve of Dam
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The shape of the dam is the basis for the dam to resist tides and ensure its safety. This paper establishes a BP neural network model to simulate the wave impact force while the tidal force was calculated based on the lunar and solar partial magnetic fields. The stability of two different shapes of sandcastles under the influence of these two impact forces are also calculated. Considering the influence of the optimal shape and the mixing ratio of sand and water, a liquid bridge model is established to research and analysis the stability of the particles in the dam under different liquid volume fractions. The best sand-water mixing ratio is obtained, which not only satisfies the best three-dimensional shape of the dam, but also determines the best sand-water mixing ratio. the diversion channel and performance are quantified to sensitivity analysis of the inclination angle to influence the diversion channel s degree of dam. The simulation results show that this strategy can reduce the impact of seawater on the sandcastle as well as extending the life of the dam.

articleTitle: TELL ME YOUR FEELINGS: Characterization and Analysis of Human Comfort in Human-Robot Collaborative Manufacturing Contexts
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Robotics technology has been widely utilized for multiple applications in recent years. Human comfort has a direct impact on task quality and efficiency during the human-robot collaboration process. As an emerging study, human comfort in human-robot collaboration attracts more and more attention of scholars. In this study, we propose a novel approach to characterize and analyze human comfort based on T-Test to advance the understanding of human factors for the future of smart manufacturing. A factor set of robot performance and work environments that affect human comfort in the human-robot collaboration process is developed. We implement the proposed method to a high-diversity group of participants who are from different educational backgrounds, ages, genders, and countries. Experimental results and analysis indicate that the comfort levels of subjects are effectively evaluated under different/same robot/work environment factors. In addition, the highly statistically significant factors that affect the participants’ comfort level positively or negatively are discussed.

articleTitle: Transformer Oil-Paper Insulation Aging Evaluation System Based on Different Aging Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In order to improve the evaluation effect of the aging state of transformer oil-paper insulation, a transformer oil-paper insulation aging evaluation system based on a variety of different aging characteristics is proposed. First, extract the aging characteristics of evaluation method of oil-paper insulation aging, such as: polarization depolarization current method, frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy, furfural content in oil, and average degree of polymerization of oil paper; then, based on MATLAB, each different aging characteristics are modeled according to the formula and encapsulation; Finally, establish normalization standards for different aging characteristics, unify the evaluation effects of aging characteristics, and establish a transformer oil-paper insulation aging evaluation system. By inputting the actual measured transformer PDC data, FDS data and furfural content data, it is verified that the evaluation results of the system are consistent with the actual situation, and the practicability of the system is verified. The results prove that the evaluation system can improve the evaluation effect of the insulation aging state, and the positioning of the aging state is more accurate.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Lower Limb Power-Assisted Exoskeleton Robots: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Powered lower limb exoskeleton robots can be divided into 3 types according to their functions: rehabilitation exoskeleton, power-assisted exoskeleton and load-bearing exoskeleton. The lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot has broad application prospects due to its light weight, small size and good human-machine compatibility. The four key technologies including mechanical structure design, drive system design, human movement intention recognition, and control system design will be illustrated. For different technologies, a detailed comparison between existing solutions is provided. The remaining unresolved problems and future directions are also discussed in detail to further improve the efficiency, safety and usability of the technology.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Spatial Grasp Prediction Model for Humanoid Multi-fingered Hand Using Deep Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: High-Dof grasping with humanoid multi-fingered hands is of great significance because of its wide application in dexterous manipulation scenarios. Unfortunately, due to the complexity of grasp representation and high dimensionality for multi-fingered hand, most of the current research works on obtaining two-fingered grasp candidates which require a grasp sampling process. This approach is time-consuming, especially when the grasp pose is spatial. Therefore, in this paper, we abandon this scheme and propose an end-to-end data-driven model to directly predict the spatial grasp contact points for the humanoid multi-fingered hand that considers both the object geometric attributes and gripper characteristics. It takes the object point clouds and 3-D model of the multi-fingered hand as inputs and requires no sampling or search process. Additionally, a grasping dataset is built for our model to ensure that the predicted grasp points satisfy the force closure metrics and grasp reachability. We verify our model both on the simulation test dataset and an actual humanoid service robot with two multi-fingered hands, the results demonstrate that the proposed model is able to realize finely grasping on novel objects.

articleTitle: Transformation from System Design Models in SysML to Executable IEC 61499 Function Block Models
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Designing automation systems requires a joint effort from different domains including the control software and controlled plants. System design is the foundation of the discipline-specific design processes and hence its verification is critical to the success of the whole project. Transforming system design models to simulation models is a common method for system verification. IEC 61499 Function Block (FB) is a feasible target simulation modeling language because of its executable specification nature. However, existing approaches can only generate initial control design from SysML models, which means the generated FB models are not executable. In this study, an approach to transform SysML design models into executable FB models is proposed. First, the execution semantics of hybrid automaton (HA) and execution control chart (ECC), which are the behavior modeling formalisms of SysML and IEC 61499, respectively is analyzed. Then, their semantic similarities and differences are identified. Finally, transformation rules to tackle the semantic differences are proposed so that the missing execution details of FB models can be automatically generated. A CNC bending machine is used as a case study to illustrate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control of Flying Manipulator Based on Exponential Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In order to achieve the purpose of keeping the trajectory of the end of the manipulator stable when the flying manipulator is subjected to internal disturbances and external disturbances, this paper designs a sliding mode control algorithm based on the exponential reaching law to strengthen the anti-interference However, this method will cause chattering of the control law due to the larger upper bound of the interference. Therefore, a fuzzy sliding mode control method is designed on the basis of the above algorithm, and the coefficient of the switching gain term in the exponential reaching law sliding mode control algorithm is adaptively adjusted through fuzzy control to weaken the chattering of the control law. And use the Lyapunov stability criterion to prove the stability of the control system. And through simulation, the method not only retains the robustness of the exponential reaching law sliding mode control algorithm, but also effectively weakens the chattering problem of the sliding mode control law, and improves the estimated tracking control of the end of the flying manipulator.

articleTitle: The Dynamics Research of Quadruped Robotics with Flexible Spine: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Flexible spine motion of the quadruped has a decisive influence on the explosive power, energy utilization efficiency, stability, terrain-pass ability, and balance ability of the quadruped during running motion. The passive dynamics models and analysis methods of quadruped robotics with flexible spine are summarized to infer the kinetic mechanism. Furthermore, the current situation and future development of the quadruped robotic prototype with flexible spine are analyzed. Finally, the improvement of dynamic performance brought by the flexible spine motion to the movement of the quadruped robotics is concluded. These provide a theoretical basis and technical guidance for the design and control algorithm of the quadruped robotics.

articleTitle: SPIL: A Shape Preserving Method for Improving Lane Width Accuracy of HD Maps
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The characteristic of high accuracy of HD maps is critical to ensure safety for autonomous driving. However, this accuracy evaluation on entire data is mostly infeasible by the measurements of absolute and relative accuracy due to the fact that the ground truth data is not easily obtained over a large geographical range. This paper proposes an alternate method using lane with accuracy for its expected or designed value is available in most occasions. Furthermore, we identify optimization opportunities and design a shape preserving algorithm SPIL for improving the accuracy of lane width through the adjustment of endpoints of assignable boundary line segments. Finally experiments are performed on a real typical urban road dataset, and experimental results demonstrate that SPIL algorithm achieves above fifty percent accuracy performance improvement.

articleTitle: Pose Calibration Algorithm for Cable Assembly Collaborative Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Facing the cable assembly process of the cable cabinet of the UAV ground station, a method of directly calibrating using the spherical probe at the end of the collaborative robot is proposed. This paper proposes an algorithm for solving the conversion matrix from the cable cabinet coordinate system to the robot coordinate system. The experiment proves that this method can meet the actual working requirements of collaborative robots to assist in indicating the position of the cable jack.

articleTitle: A Survey of Research on Stability Guarantee of Reinforcement Learning Automatic Control Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved numerous theoretical and application results in the field of control, but the exploration of dangerous situations in many practical situations limits the application scenarios of the learning methods. This paper makes a systematic introduction and summary of the safety methods of reinforcement learning. It sorts out the ideas for solving safety from two aspects: model-based methods which use the model knowledge to ensure safety and model-free methods which change the learning object or process to give safety guarantees. Finally, we discuss the future research directions and prospects of these problems.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Grabbing System Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Collaborative robots are gradually being used in various fields of industrial production with the advent of the era of intelligent manufacturing. Adding deep learning to the target detection system and integrating it into the ROS system to identify the object to be grasped and complete the positioning is the basis for achieving intelligent grasping by collaborative robots. Based on deep learning, this article uses the inception model to complete the network structure optimization of the SSD model. Then, this article uses the repulsion loss to complete the optimization of the loss function to build a target detection system. Finally, this article completes the grasping experiment.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Attending Doctor Selection Using Fuzzy Preference Relations Based AHP and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Attending doctor selection has always been a complicated issue that single decision-maker is hard to make a relatively comprehensive assessment which may easily cause the occurrence of medical disputes. Group decision-making method which considering patient preferences while arranging attending doctors is suitable to solve this problem. However, it is difficult for patients and their families to make crisp and overmuch judgements in most situations. Herein, a hybrid group decision-making methodology based on fuzzy technique for order performance by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) which combined fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and prospect theory is proposed to rank the alternative attending doctors. Fuzzy AHP is utilized for analyzing the problem and determining the weight of each evaluation criterion from only n – 1 pairwise comparisons. Considering the limited rationality and risk preference of decision makers (patients and their families), prospect theory and fuzzy TOPSIS are utilized for analyzing and ranking the attending doctors according to the preferences of patients and their families. To perform the validation of the proposed methodology, an illustrative case is selected in this paper. The application of this methodology could better prevent and reduce the occurrence of medical disputes and improve patients’ satisfaction.

articleTitle: FEE: An Event Extraction Model for Flood and Drought Disaster Based on Sequence Labeling
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Due to unique climatic characteristics, China suffers from frequent disasters such as typhoons, droughts, and floods almost every year. It is necessary to study the disasters from history. The event extraction model is effective to mine disaster events from historical documents to help people organize historical event information in a more structured way. Common approaches transform the event extraction task into a sequence labeling task by modeling words with a static vector regardless of polysemy, which affects the performance of event extraction. We propose an event extraction model named FEE. It introduces dynamic word vectors to the BiLSTM-CRF mechanism, which solves the problem that existing models do not consider the ambiguity of words, and makes the result of event extraction more accurate. Experimental results on flood and drought disaster dataset and general dataset show that our model outperforms traditional models on precision, recall, and F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>.

articleTitle: Singularity Configuration Pass Algorithm of Manipulator Based on PVT Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In order to satisfy the requirement that Cartesian space trajectory planning requires high real-time calculation of inverse kinematics of the manipulator, the analytical solution method is used to calculate the inverse kinematics of the tandem manipulator. According to the judgment conditions in the process of obtaining the analytical solution, three kinds of singular configuration situations that the manipulator may encounter in the process of obtaining the inverse solution are determined. For the singular configuration, a manipulator singularity based on PVT trajectory planning is proposed. The configuration passes the algorithm, so that the robot arm can maintain the continuity and stability of the motion of the robot arm when passing through the singular configuration. Finally, the algorithm was verified from two aspects of theory and experimental data simulation, and the result analysis showed that the algorithm was correct and feasible. This method has good adaptability to traditional industrial six-axis manipulators, cooperative six-axis manipulators and redundant seven-degree-of-freedom manipulators.

articleTitle: Queueing Delay Analysis of Mixed Traffic in Time Sensitive Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: In many emerging Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) applications such as industrial control and automotive, periodic traffic with end-to-end latency constraints is buffered with nonmission-critical aperiodic traffic. As queueing delay is a central component of end-to-end latency, we study the effect of aperiodic traffic on the queueing delay of periodic traffic via characterizing the probability distribution of queue size and delay in an (M + D)/M/1 queue, a queue with Poisson and periodic inputs, infinite waiting capacity and a single memoryless server. Since obtaining the closed form distributions of the queue size and delay is intractable, we approximate the behavior of the (M + D)/M/1 queue when the service and arrival rates are close. We use a Markov chain with a quasitoeplitz matrix, enabling us to use an existing technique to study this class of Markov chains. We determine the transition matrix of the Markov chain, investigate the setting in which the approximation works well, and compute the stationary distribution. We plot and compare the stationary distributions of queue size and delay between the (M + D)/M/1 queue and our model; we observe that our model is a favorable match.

articleTitle: A Visual Target Tracking Algorithm Integrating Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: Aiming at the situation that the Siamese tracking algorithm is easy to track drift or loss under complex conditions such as target deformation and similar object interference, a target tracking algorithm combining DeblurGAN deblurring module and spatiotemporal attention mechanism is proposed. First, the input video frames are removed. Fuzzy preprocessing. After simple data enhancement, CIResNet, a feature extraction network embedded with the attention module, enables the model to spontaneously and adaptively perform weighting operations on different semantic target feature channels, thereby enhancing the generalization ability of the tracking model. Finally, online reorganization and independent training are used to train the modified algorithm, and the target tracking benchmark data set OTB100 is used to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze and evaluate the improved algorithm. In order to prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, experiments are carried out to compare and analyze with six typical tracking algorithms in the current field. The results show that the proposed algorithm has obvious advantages in tracking indicators such as accuracy and success rate under the interference of multiple different attributes.

articleTitle: Adaptive Consensus Control of Networked Lagrangian Systems with Input Hysteresis Quantization and Asynchronous Sampled-Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: The consensus of a group of Lagrangian multi-agent systems with quantized inputs and time-varying gain is studied in our paper. At the mean time, the input disturbance problem is fully considered. It is assumed that both the external disturbance and the control gain signal are bounded in our research. In addition, considering that each system needs to communicate with its neighbors to update its control law, and the communication data is limited by the bandwidth and other physical factors. In order to solve this problem, a multi-agent consensus control law with communication sampling function is designed. Through the carefully designed control signal, each subsystem can achieve the final asymptotical consensus under the directed communication topology, and the rationality of the control law design process is verified by the simulation experiment at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Global Uniform Bounded Tracking Control for Multi-Lagrangian Systems with Input Quantization under Directed Communication Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Control, Robotics and Cybernetics (CRC)
abstract: This paper investigates the consensus of a group of Lagrangian multi-agent systems with quantized inputs and time-varying gain. At the same time, the input disturbance problem is also fully considered. Because the control gain is easily disturbed by external factors, including input disturbance. In this paper, it is assumed that the control gain and external disturbance have corresponding upper bounds. In view of these upper bounds, we design the adaptive control rate carefully to counteract the influence of these upper bounds on the system. In addition, each subsystem has a quantized input signal and our well-designed control law can compensate the nonlinear characteristics of the system caused by this quantized signal. Finally, the system can achieve the ultimate uniformly bounded output characteristics. The simulation results at the end of the paper further verify that all signals in the closed-loop system are bounded, and also verify the rationality of the design scheme.
